ContentDecomposedElement.description: A node of the decomposed format's skeleton tree: the element's structure with no property values, which this format serves separately through the page's `data` and `assignments` maps, keyed by this node's `id`. The grammar is: `id`, `component` and `slots` always present, an empty `slots` map serialized as `[]`; `style` present only when the element carries style, omitted entirely otherwise; `apiAlias` present on every node at every depth and written last. Key order on the wire is `id`, `component`, `slots`, `style`, `apiAlias`. This node type shares its `slots` grammar with the skeleton format's node (`ContentSkeletonElement`) and differs from it only on `apiAlias` placement.

id.description: Element identifier, carried through from the stored element. Unique across every root of the page, and the key this element's entry in the page `assignments` map is filed under.

component.description: Element component type (e.g. Sw:Grid:Container, Sw:Content:Text, Sw:Media:Image).

slots.description: Child element subtrees keyed by slot name, each slot holding an ordered list of child nodes. Always present on every node at every depth: a node with no slots carries it as an empty JSON array `[]` rather than an empty object.

oneOf.description: The empty slot map, serialized as `[]`.

style.description: Universal presentation options keyed by option wire name, carried through from the stored element. Each value is either a single scalar (a flat option) or an object keyed by breakpoint (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl) for a breakpoint-aware option, per the option's breakpointAware flag in the style-option introspection schema. Omitted when the element has no style.

apiAlias.description: Present on EVERY node at every depth, written last, with the value `content_skeleton_element`. The decomposed encoder holds this alias as its own constant; a client must read it off the node it is looking at rather than infer it from the node's position in the tree.
